title: The Virgin Today
byline: A Christmas hymn of St. Romanos the Melodist

english: Today the Virgin gives birth to the One beyond all being,
and the earth offers a cave to the One no one can approach.
and Magi journey with a star;

latin: Παιδίον νέον, ὁ πρὸ αἰώνων Θεός.
english: a little Child, God before the ages.
